en.headline: Chief Justice Cheung to attend global rule of law conference in Singapore
en.dek: He will depart tomorrow and return on 29 November, with Justice Roberto Ribeiro serving as Acting Chief Justice during his absence.
body: The Judiciary said Chief Justice Andrew Cheung of the Court of Final Appeal will leave for Singapore tomorrow to attend the Global Rule of Law Conference 2026.

The conference will bring together judicial leaders, scholars and legal professionals to discuss how the rule of law can advance international co-operation and development, strengthen social cohesion and help societies respond to a rapidly changing global environment. During the event, Chief Justice Cheung will take part in a high-level discussion with the chief justices of Canada, Jamaica, Malaysia and New Zealand, moderated by Singapore’s Chief Justice Sundaresh Menon.

He will also attend commemorative events marking the bicentennial of Singapore’s judicial system. Chief Justice Cheung is scheduled to return to Hong Kong on 29 November. In his absence, Permanent Judge of the Court of Final Appeal Mr Justice Roberto Ribeiro will serve as Acting Chief Justice.
The Judiciary issued the announcement on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 張舉能明日赴新加坡出席全球法治會議
zh.dek: 終院首席法官將於29日返港，期間由常任法官李義署任首席法官。
body: 司法機構表示，終審法院首席法官張舉能將於明日前往新加坡，出席2026年全球法治會議。
會議將匯聚司法領袖、學者及法律專業人士，探討法治如何促進國際合作與發展、加強社會凝聚力，以及協助社會應對迅速變化的全球環境。會議期間，張舉能將與加拿大、牙買加、馬來西亞及新西蘭的首席法官進行高層討論，由新加坡首席法官梅農主持。
他亦會出席配合會議舉行、紀念新加坡司法制度二百周年的活動。張舉能預計於11月29日返港。離港期間，終審法院常任法官李義將署任首席法官。
司法機構於周二公布有關安排。
